summary: Backend auth, role permissions, cookie /me, cancellation/history, and fresh UI login/board/quick-add were tested. Occupied booking status editing is blocked in the UI by an invalid PATCH payload.

minor.issue: Existing regression test uses fixed 2099-01-01 data and fails with 409 on repeat; test isolation/cleanup is needed.

integration_issues.issue: BookingDialog submits the complete form including chair_id, date, start_time, and duration_minutes for an existing booking. Backend correctly rejects slot-changing fields with 400, so status updates and cancellation cannot be completed from the UI.

issues: The responsive board remains a horizontally scrollable 9-column grid; this was observed as the current mobile strategy, not a blocking overflow defect.

action_items: When editing an occupied booking, submit only mutable fields (status, patient_name, patient_id) or make the backend ignore unchanged slot fields; then retest status and cancellation UI.
Use unique dates and cleanup fixtures in backend regression tests to avoid repeat-run 409 collisions.
critical_code_review_comments: BookingDialog reuses the create payload for PATCH, contradicting the backend's safe slot-change guard and breaking the required occupied status workflow.
The existing backend test suite is not repeatable because it leaves fixed-date bookings in the shared database.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_HISTORY-prefixed booking on a unique future date, cancelled it, and verified it through /api/bookings/history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fresh reception login and board dimensions passed. Cookie login and /api/auth/me passed with HttpOnly cookie. Fix the PATCH payload in BookingDialog before retesting occupied status/cancel and WebSocket refresh across two pages.
rca of the issue: BookingDialog initializes form state with immutable slot fields and sends the entire form object for PATCH. The backend deliberately rejects any request containing chair/date/start/duration to prevent unsafe rescheduling, producing the visible 400 error 'Rescheduling requires a new conflict-checked booking'.
